d:
Japan showed ZERO FEAR when they faced Dirk Nowitzki and Germany at the 2006 FIBA Basketball World Championship!
The Japanese squad brought energy, skill and determination, making Germany work hard for every possession. Even against one of the biggest stars in basketball, Japan refused to back down!
Dirk and Germany eventually secured an 81-70 victory, but Japan definitely made an impression!
